svg.title: QProbe: mixed rate, accuracy and discrimination, iterations 1-35
svg.desc: Selected Top512/E0, pre-fit. Existing aggregate data only; no new sampling. A: mixed fraction and accuracies. B: trailing 10-iteration Pearson. C: selected binary ROC AUC. D: within-iteration sample-std Pearson. Trailing 5-iteration means start at iteration 5. Rolling windows overlap. Unselected 4608 candidates have no actual labels; not full-5120 accuracy. Iterations 1-5 and CP5 restore from iteration 6 form one logical sequence. All SVG lettering is embedded as vector glyph outlines.

g.aria-label: QProbe: mixed rate, accuracy and discrimination
Iterations 1-35 | selected Top512 / E0 | pre-fit predictions | existing data only; no new sampling
(B) Mixed rate vs. accuracy: rolling Pearson
10-iteration trailing windows; each point is the window end
ROC AUC of pre-fit mixed probability; chance = 0.50
Within-iteration Pearson across the selected 512 questions
Scope: only selected Top512/E0 are labeled; unselected 4608 have no actual labels. These are not full-5120 accuracies.
Rolling windows overlap; correlations are descriptive. Iterations 1-5 and CP5 restore from iteration 6 form one logical sequence.
Means are trailing and begin at iteration 5; rolling Pearson begins at iteration 10. No new sampling, model forward or evaluation.
